info.name: MOTABIQ — Identity Verification v1 — all cases (ICD v2.2)
info.description:
All request/response cases of the MOTABIQ verification API for <Bank>, per ICD v2.2.

1. Import this collection and BOTH environment files (`YourBank-Test`, `YourBank-Production`). Select an environment top-right.
2. Run **0 · Setup / Get encryption certificate** once per environment.
3. Fill the collection variables `nationalNumber`, `deviceId` (scanner serial) and `biometricImage` (base64 WSQ / 8-bit grey PNG) for the real cases.
4. Every encrypted request builds its JWE (RSA-OAEP-256 + A256GCM) in its pre-request script — requires the Postman **desktop** app v10+.

Test environment: safe to experiment. Production: real government lookups, billed per successful verification.

Error cases in folder 2 carry synthetic images (no real biometrics) and need no data from you.

exec: // Fresh UUID v7 per call (ICD §2.3) — override by setting collectionVariable requestId yourself.
const t = Date.now(); const r = crypto.randomBytes(10);

variable.description: Replace with a real national number (NNNN-NNNN-NNNN).
Serial number of the fingerprint scanner (from the SDK). Register it in the client portal → Devices.
Base64 of a real capture: WSQ or 8-bit greyscale PNG, 500 ppi, NFIQ 2 ≥ 40.

request.description: Run this first. Saves `kid` and `certPem`; every encrypted request builds its JWE from them (ICD §4.2.4, §4.4). Re-run whenever the certificate rotates.

Set collection variables `nationalNumber`, `fingerPosition`, `deviceId` (scanner serial) and `biometricImage` (base64 WSQ or 8-bit greyscale PNG, 500 ppi, ICD §4.2.3). A 200 means *processed*: read `result.verification.verification` — MATCH / NO_MATCH / NO_VERIFICATION_POSSIBLE. On NO_MATCH no personal data is returned. **Production performs a real government lookup and is billed.**

exec: // ---- MOTABIQ JWE helper (RSA-OAEP-256 + A256GCM, ICD §4.2.4). Postman desktop v10+ ----
if (!certPem || !kid) throw new Error('Run "0 · Setup / Get encryption certificate" first.');
const header = { alg: 'RSA-OAEP-256', enc: 'A256GCM', kid: kid };
const encryptedKey = crypto.publicEncrypt({ key: pub, padding: crypto.constants.RSA_PKCS1_OAEP_PADDING, oaepHash: 'sha256' }, cek);

pm.collectionVariables.set('encryptedPayload', buildJwe({ nationalNumber: pm.collectionVariables.get("nationalNumber"), deviceId: pm.collectionVariables.get("deviceId"), biometrics: { fingerPosition: Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("fingerPosition")), image: pm.collectionVariables.get("biometricImage") } }));
if (b.result.verification.verification === 'NO_MATCH') pm.test('no person data on NO_MATCH', () => pm.expect(b.result.person).to.be.undefined);

request.description: For a person who physically cannot give a fingerprint (ICD §4.2.2 `exception`). Identity lookup only; verdict `EXEMPT`. `reason` ∈ HAND_INJURY, AMPUTATION, WORN_PRINTS, MEDICAL, OTHER. No `deviceId` needed.

if (!certPem || !kid) throw new Error('Run "0 · Setup / Get encryption certificate" first.');

const encryptedKey = crypto.publicEncrypt({ key: pub, padding: crypto.constants.RSA_PKCS1_OAEP_PADDING, oaepHash: 'sha256' }, cek);

pm.collectionVariables.set('encryptedPayload', buildJwe({ nationalNumber: pm.collectionVariables.get("nationalNumber"), exception: { reason: "HAND_INJURY", note: "customer has no readable prints" } }));
